name: email-himalaya
description: External email PROVIDER (EmailHimalaya): implements email@1 ON TOP OF the himalaya@1 service (never a CLI/docker/ssh detail of its own). No `accounts` is a valid NOT-CONFIGURED state: the plugin loads, reports it and answers calls with a structured error.

config.description: Accounts are LABELS mapped to himalaya account names; credentials are NAMES resolved at call time through the credentials capability, never values.

defaultAccount.description: Account label used when a call passes no account; default: the first configured account

accounts.description: Accounts by label: { address?, accountName?, credential?, folder? }. `accountName` is the account name in himalaya's own config (default: the label); `credential` is a credential NAME resolved at call time, never a value

registerWithKernel.description: Also feed the kernel-hosted email@1 service when the deployment has one (backward compatibility); set false to serve only the plugins-repo `mail` service

himalayaWaitMs.description: Bound of the SOFT wait for the himalaya service at load (ordering hint, never a dependency)
